objective: Implement Part 4 as an evidence-grounded Deep Research / Agent Prompt Architect without duplicating existing prompt creation/enhancement or granting capabilities the host may not possess.

constraints.text: Current user directive activates project plan Part 4.
Prompt Creator and Prompt Enhancer must retain one shared specification core rather than duplicated logic.
Research questions must remain distinct from desired final agent behavior and requirements.
No model/tool/browser/web/Deep Research capability may be invented by configuration.
constraints.provenance: Host capability boundary + Part 4 acceptance criteria

constraints.text: Research-generated prompts must pass Prompt Enhancer, Reasoning Auditor and main-host governance before deployment.

claims.text: Research-brief architecture is a distinct responsibility from final system-prompt specification.
Making research optional avoids unnecessary latency and ceremony when stable supplied context already determines the prompt specification.
Deep Research output should be treated as evidence/candidate specification rather than canonical deployment authority.

assumptions.text: A real production session is still needed to measure whether generated research briefs improve downstream agent quality.
assumptions.provenance: No empirical Part 4 production trial in this release

alternatives.option: Duplicate Prompt Creator/Enhancer logic inside a Deep Research agent.
alternatives.reason: Creates competing specification logic and unnecessary maintenance drift.

alternatives.option: Make Deep Research mandatory for every new agent.
alternatives.reason: Violates latency/optimality goals when research cannot change a material decision.

alternatives.option: Add only a profile label with no explicit research-vs-agent-contract policy.
alternatives.reason: Would not deterministically enforce Part 4 separation and capability boundaries.

alternatives.option: Add an optional research-brief profile/module/policy and reuse existing enhancement/audit/governance gates.
alternatives.reason: Smallest non-duplicative architecture satisfying all Part 4 acceptance criteria.

decision: Activate deep_research_agent_architect as an optional evidence precursor. It creates a self-contained research brief with TARGET_AGENT_CONTRACT and RESEARCH_AGENDA separated, keeps unverified capabilities unknown, treats research output as noncanonical evidence, and routes generated prompts through Prompt Enhancer -> Reasoning Auditor -> MAIN_HOST_GATE.

unknowns.text: Practical research-brief quality and downstream prompt improvement are not yet measured on a real agent-development task.
unknowns.provenance: Release 0.21 implements architecture and deterministic validation only.

unknowns.text: Whether a given host can actually execute Deep Research/web/browser operations is host-dependent and must be checked at runtime.
